title: Staufen Baumaschinen GmbH
description: Staufen Baumaschinen GmbH is a German company specializing in the sale, rental, and service of construction machinery and equipment. Founded in 1983, it operates from locations in Göppingen, Haubersbronn, and Backnang, offering a large rental fleet, workshop services, spare parts, and training.*once the timer expires, the files will be available for sale — submit your request to the operator https://www.staufen-baumaschinen.de
